title: Why Loyalty Cards With 2 Free Stamps Finish Faster (Goal Gradient)
alt_title_1: 34% vs 19%: The 2006 Car-Wash Study on Artificial Head Starts
alt_title_2: How Starting Every Project at 20% Beats Blank Checklists
description_hook: Building on Clark Hull's 1932 Goal-Gradient Hypothesis, marketing researchers Ran Kivetz, Oleg Urminsky, and Yuhuang Zheng proved in 2006 that a 12-stamp card with 2 free stamps completed at 34% versus 19% for an identical 10-stamp card.

scenes.headline: 12 Stamps Minus 2 Beat 10 Blank Stamps
bullets: Card B: 12 boxes with 2 pre-stamped -> 34% finished
scenes.narration: Why did a twelve-stamp loyalty card with two free stamps nearly double completion over a blank ten-stamp card requiring identical purchases?
scenes.source: Kivetz, Urminsky & Zheng, Journal of Marketing Research (2006)

scenes.headline: Hull (1932) & Kivetz, Urminsky, Zheng (2006)
bullets: Clark Hull (1932): subjects speed up near visible finish lines
Kivetz et al. (2006): starting at 17% triggered faster repeat visits
scenes.narration: Psychologist Clark Hull noticed in 1932 that effort speeds up near a finish line. In 2006, Ran Kivetz, Oleg Urminsky, and Yuhuang Zheng proved illusory head starts lifted car-wash card completion from nineteen percent to thirty-four.
scenes.source: Clark Hull, Psych. Review (1932); Kivetz, Urminsky & Zheng, JMR (2006)

scenes.headline: Zero Percent Kills Good Projects in Week One
scenes.left_body: 'Save $10,000 from $0' -> feels endless -> stalls by Tuesday
scenes.right_body: 10-box card with setup & first $50 logged as Boxes 1 & 2
scenes.narration: Starting a new savings fund or digital project at zero percent feels miles from done, causing most beginners to stall in week one.

scenes.headline: Pre-Stamp Steps 1 and 2 on Every Sprint
scenes.stat_label: NEARER FINISH LINES MULTIPLY EXECUTION VELOCITY
scenes.stat_subtext: Break goals into 10-step cards • Credit setup as Steps 1 & 2
scenes.narration: Pre-stamp your own milestones: break big goals into ten-step sprints, and log account setup and outline notes as steps one and two immediately.

scenes.headline: Start Every Card Already in Motion
scenes.stat_label: ENGINEER MOMENTUM BEFORE HARD REPS BEGIN
bullets: Let the Goal-Gradient pull you through the final 8
scenes.narration: Never stare at zero percent when a twenty-percent head start pulls your brain across the finish line.
scenes.source: Mind & Margin rule based on Kivetz, Urminsky & Zheng (2006)
